A report over the layers it extends

Source: R/spec_study.R
tfl_resolve_output.Rd

tfl_resolve_output() puts a report's own file over the layers its extends names (defaults, patterns/<name>), nearest last. Maps (page's lines by number, tokens, codelists, a call's arguments) merge by key, and an tfl_unset() removes the key. In content, the report's items of one function replace every item of that function in the layers below, in the place the first of them had; a function the report does not have keeps the layers' items; a function only the report has goes after them. The content of defaults is a table's (normalize_ard, the digits ...): a figure or a listing takes its other parts (page, codelists), not its content. A pattern's content (patterns/<name>, chosen report by report) layers onto any kind. extends: none uses no layer. The report's style (style: compact, a set of defaults.yml's styles:; standard when it names none) is the nearest layer below its own: the look it picks, content and page. A template SPEC (template: {name, args}) puts the template's items (tfl_template_expand(), marked template:<name>) between the layers and the report's own – its look (plan_style, the widths, the rows a page ...) under the study's layers, which say the look and win – and its ard: under the report's (an entry of the report's replaces the template's of the same id); a template parameter that says where its study default is takes it from the layers when the SPEC does not give it, and a SPEC value over a different one says so. Each item's from says where it came from. The result holds no tfl_unset.

Usage

tfl_resolve_output(output, study, provenance = FALSE)

Arguments

output

A tfl_output as read from its file.

study

A tfl_study_spec (its defaults and patterns).

provenance

TRUE to say where each content item's arguments come from: each item gets arg_from (a named character vector, one an argument: "own", "defaults" or "pattern:<name>"; a verb whose ... is named, such as plan_cells(), by top-level key, any other verb one layer's whole) and below (the same verb's item with the report's own layer left out, NULL when no layer has it: what a revert goes back to). FALSE (default): the items as they are.

Value

The tfl_output, resolved (attribute resolved = TRUE).

Examples

d <- system.file("extdata", "spec-yaml", package = "tflspec")
s <- tfl_read_study_spec(d)
out <- tfl_resolve_output(tfl_read_outputs(d)[["T-14-1-1"]], s)
vapply(out$content, function(it) paste(it$fn, it$from), "")
#>  [1] "table_plan own"           "plan_cells own"          
#>  [3] "plan_labels own"          "plan_digits own"         
#>  [5] "plan_col_header defaults" "plan_stub defaults"      
#>  [7] "plan_blanks defaults"     "plan_paginate_rows own"  
#>  [9] "plan_style defaults"      "plan_cell_style own"
